_comment: Project-side audit config for milnet01/RetroArch. See docs/private/audit/README.md for usage. Edit this file when a tool's invocation changes; do NOT pin tool flags in the global /audit skill.

known_issues: menu/drivers/materialui.c (12231 LoC) historically times out at default --max-configs. Pass --max-configs=1 if a partial run is observed (the 2026-04-25 run ended at 449/450 files).
Output is XML by default — pipe to docs/private/audit/aggregate.py --from-cppcheck before triage.
JNI cb sites in play_feature_delivery emit missingReturn FPs; see suppressions.md S12.
location_drivers[] / translation_drivers[] OOB are NULL-terminator FPs — see suppressions.md.
runahead.c:640/662 needs a reproducer before fixing — see suppressions.md.

clazy.low_yield_note: Qt UI is small (ui_qt_widgets.cpp only). Defer unless a change touches ui/qt; expected yield <5 findings.

known_issues: The 2026-04-25 run reported 332 parse errors across the C dialect; rerun with a pinned semgrep version (>=1.50) and re-evaluate. Until then, the double-free cluster (29 sites) is a documented FP class — see suppressions.md S9.

gitleaks.demote_priority: 0 actionable findings on the 2026-04-25 baseline — promote to /audit --all only; no project secrets in source.
gitleaks.iteration_pattern: Iterate over the in-scope source dirs (input/ menu/ network/ tasks/ gfx/ audio/ cheevos/ command.c configuration.c retroarch.c runloop.c) one at a time and merge the per-dir reports — gitleaks has no --skip-dirs flag and a top-level scan eats CPU on libretro-common assets.

trivy.demote_priority: no lockfiles in scope — vendored deps are pinned by tarball. The vuln scan is empty by construction; secret scan is redundant with gitleaks. Promote to /audit --all only.

ruff.low_yield_note: no Python in core scope; only audit/build helpers. Expected yield: 0-2 findings.

bandit.low_yield_note: no Python in core scope. Expected yield: 0 findings.

presets._comment: Map /audit invocations to tool sets. Default = the 2026-04 run, minus expected-clean tools.

incremental._comment: When invoked as /audit --since <ref>, restrict each tool to files changed since <ref>. anchor defaults to master.

tool_gaps: clang-tidy not run (no compile_commands.json — now generated via bear)
clazy not run (deferred until ui/qt change)
